title: LiteLLM
description: Usage de la passerelle LiteLLM d'après son journal de dépenses (base litellm, table LiteLLM_SpendLogs). Aucun contenu de requête n'est lisible d'ici.

list.name: model_group
list.label: Modèle
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" ORDER BY 1

list.name: team_id
list.label: Équipe
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') <> 'success'))::float8 / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})

SELECT COALESCE(sum(spend), 0) FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE cache_hit = 'True'))::float8 / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval, 0),
       COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') AS metric,
       count(*) * 60000.0 / $__interval_ms AS value
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval),
       (count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') <> 'success'))::float8 / count(*) AS value
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latence p50 / p95
panels.description: Requêtes réussies. request_duration_ms, sinon endTime - startTime.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval),
       percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d) AS "p50",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d) AS "p95"
FROM (SELECT "startTime", COALESCE(request_duration_ms, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000)::float8 AS d
      FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
      WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
        AND COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success') s
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval, 0),
       COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) AS "prompt",
       COALESCE(sum(completion_tokens), 0) AS "completion"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Coût par équipe
panels.description: Dépense comptée par LiteLLM, en USD. Les modèles locaux coûtent 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval, 0),
       COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') AS metric, sum(spend) AS value

panels.title: Appels d'outils MCP
panels.description: Appels d'outils MCP passés par LiteLLM, par outil. Filtré par équipe seulement : le filtre Modèle ne s'applique pas ici.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval, 0),
       mcp_namespaced_tool_name AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(mcp_namespaced_tool_name, '') <> ''
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 50 dernières requêtes en échec
panels.description: Le message d'erreur est dans metadata, que ce rôle ne peut pas lire : chercher le request_id dans les logs (Explore → Loki).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "startTime" AS "Heure",
       COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') AS "Modèle",
       model AS "Déploiement",
       custom_llm_provider AS "Fournisseur",
       call_type AS "Type",
       team_id AS "Équipe",
       status AS "Statut",
       COALESCE(request_duration_ms, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000)::float8 AS "Durée (ms)",
       total_tokens AS "Tokens",
       mcp_namespaced_tool_name AS "Outil MCP",
       request_id,
       session_id
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '(aucun)') IN (${model_group:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(team_id, ''), '(aucune)') IN (${team_id:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(status, 'success') <> 'success'
ORDER BY "startTime" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Erreurs dans les logs par agent
Exécutions de flows (période)
panels.description: Fins d'exécution des flows servis par prefect-flows (organize-inbox, sort-mail, backup, pr-validation), d'après ses logs. Détail par flow dans l'UI Prefect.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({compose_project="platform", compose_service="prefect-flows"} |~ "Flow run '[^']+' - Finished in state" | regexp "Finished in state (?P<state>[A-Za-z]+)" | state="Completed" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({compose_project="platform", compose_service="prefect-flows"} |~ "Flow run '[^']+' - Finished in state" | regexp "Finished in state (?P<state>[A-Za-z]+)" | state=~"Failed|Crashed|TimedOut" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({compose_project="platform", compose_service="prefect-flows"} |~ "Flow run '[^']+' - Finished in state" | regexp "Finished in state (?P<state>[A-Za-z]+)" | state="Cancelled" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum by (state) (count_over_time({compose_project="platform", compose_service="prefect-flows"} |~ "Flow run '[^']+' - Finished in state" | regexp "Finished in state (?P<state>[A-Za-z]+)" [$__interval]))
